text:
Dana Morris: Quick thread for Aria Lopez's loop next Tue 10:00am PT (onsite). A few special items: Aria requested wheelchair-accessible room, an onsite sign-language interpreter for the 1:1 with hiring manager, and a short timezone-friendly interview buffer (she's traveling from MST). Also asked if we offer a caregiver stipend for travel day childcare. Can people-ops confirm what's possible?

people-ops: Hi Dana  We can arrange an accessible interview room (Ground floor, Room G2) and request an ASL interpreter. Caregiver stipend policy: we offer up to $200 reimbursement for childcare for candidate travel days upon submission of receipt. We can pre-authorize if needed. What time is the candidate arriving?

Dana Morris: Aria arrives Monday evening on the redeye, should be in by 8pm. Interview schedule is Tue 10:0011:30 PT with a 30-min break between the coding and manager interview.

facilities: Accessible room confirmed  Room G2 reserved 9:303:00. ADA ramp and elevator spot flagged; reception will escort. Also reserving a quiet, low-sensory waiting area for the candidate if needed.

Dana Morris: Thanks. ASL interpreter  can you book one for Tue 10:000:45 and again 10:4511:30 for overlap? Also need wifi guest code and a printed schedule with panel bios.

people-ops: ASL interpreter requested (vendor: SignWorks). Pending confirmation  will update when confirmed. Guest Wi-Fi: REDWOOD-GUEST code printed in packet. Printing panel bios and schedule. We'll also add a note about the low-sensory waiting area and point of contact.

Dana Morris: Candidate mentioned she uses a screen reader occasionally and prefers emailed materials beforehand. Can we email any non-sensitive interview docs and the coding prompt in plain text?

people-ops: Yes  we'll deliver plaintext versions of any materials and the coding prompt via email and also make printed large-font copies available at reception on request. We'll also include VPN and CoderPad access instructions for remote fallback.

Dana Morris: Caregiver stipend  Aria asked if we can prepay or if reimbursement is only allowed. She'd prefer prepayment if possible.

people-ops: We can issue a one-time prepaid Visa travel card for childcare up to $200 if the recruiter confirms the need and collects minimal verification. Otherwise reimbursement via Ramp after submission is available. DM me the recruiter approval and we'll issue the card.

recruiter-bot: Calendar event created: "Aria Lopez  Onsite Final Loop" Tue 10:00-11:30 PT. Accessibility notes and guest wifi attached.

Dana Morris: Great. Anything else? Aria also asked about parking close to the accessible entrance  can facilities reserve a short-term accessible space and provide directions?

facilities: Reserved accessible parking stall #A3 adjacent to Entrance C. We'll include walking directions from the pickup/dropoff point and note ramp location. Reception will meet candidate at Entrance C if she indicates arrival time.

Dana Morris: Perfect. I'll DM the recruiter's sign-off for the prepaid childcare card. Thanks team  closing loop unless someone flags an issue.
